So for the release we need to do a few things. First, uh, merge the branch with the BLE fixes and run the full test suite. Second, bump the version to 0.1.2 in the config file. Third, build the installer with the packaging script and check that it is signed. And then fourth, publish the release on GitHub and, um, send a note to the testers telling them what changed, mainly the faster startup and the new update button in settings. If anything fails in the test suite we stop and fix it first, we do not skip it, that is really important.
